$comment: Games for tests/multiplayer.test.cjs. Each build names a decrypted ROM under the repository.
Fixtures are save states captured with tests/capture_fixture.cjs into
tmp_test/fixtures/<ROM file name without extension, non-alphanumerics as _>/<scene>/.
lobby-host: the console is already hosting the game's local wireless room (it advertises it).
lobby-guest: the console is on the screen that lists nearby rooms.
Capture the two scenes in separate sessions so each console has its own address and ID.
Steps run after linking: 'key CODE MS', 'touch X Y [MS]' (fractions of the canvas), 'wait MS'.
A pairing [hostBuild, guestBuild] with different builds also checks cross-version play.

kiosk.note: The kiosk demo shows Group on its main menu, but choosing it only replays the selection animation; the demo never calls the local wireless service (checked with logFilter=Service.NWM:Debug, 2026-10-05).

mario-kart-7.title: Mario Kart 7
mario-kart-7.note: Both consoles boot fresh. Local Multiplayer lists rooms through Download Play (dlp:FKCL), and a room's info comes from the host's dlp server thread, which save states do not restore, so lobby fixtures cannot stand in for live hosting or scanning here.
